purpose: Model-safety evaluation gate. All model-safety metrics are deferred until Train1600 V3 is trained and the Locked Validation split is statistically powered (>=5 exact feasible states, per the pre-registered accrual contract). Until then this gate holds no pass and blocks all downstream deployment stages.

does_not_control: Train rounds / Calibration / Locked Validation SWMM data production

activation_preconditions: model trained on Train split only
Calibration completed on Calibration split only
Locked Validation one-shot evaluation with >=5 exact feasible states, using the accrual contract PROJECT6_V4_LOCKED_VALIDATION_ACCRUAL_V3 when short
prohibitions: must not gate or block Train1600 V3 data generation
must not be evaluated against the underpowered P3 locked evaluation
must not interpret insufficient evaluation positives as model pass
must not reuse Calibration or Locked Validation results for training or Active Learning
joint safety must be composed from the continuous/safety heads; a standalone joint classification head is never the sole safety evidence
